card.name: Bit-rate and bpm unit starts
card.fires_on: The first piece of a rate unit right after a number, such as the b in Gb/s, Mb/s, baud, or bpm. It marks the spot just before the rest of the unit is spelled out.

modes.label: Data rates
modes.description: Start of bits-per-second units like Gb/s or Mb/s after a number in speed of electronics or storage.

modes.label: Heart rate bpm
modes.description: The b in bpm after 'beats per minute (' in heart rate statements.
modes.example: heart rates of less than 50 beats per minute (<<b>>pm)

card.writes: It pushes toward unit endings like ps and away from the word year.
card.plain: It spots the first letter of units like Gb/s or bpm, right after a number.
